tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a university student who recently attended a career fair on campus. You met Ms. Anderson from a company where you are very interested in working. Write an email to Ms. Anderson.
bullets: Reiterate your interest in the company and your intention to apply for the internship program.
Describe your relevant skills and experiences.
Ask for details about the application process and position.
tasks.subject: Career Fair Follow-up
